recommended_main_contributions.name: Controlled analysis of attention implementation and task suitability

recommended_main_contributions.evidence: A/B/C each three seeds; fixed training conditions, selected-weight interventions and sensitivity analysis; B improves all three seeds versus A, h-swish does not improve mean performance over ReLU CA
recommended_main_contributions.limits: No universal attention failure or proven universal causal mechanism; L1 is single-seed exploratory only.
